measurements.name: current-baseline-selected
measurements.instruction: Use read-only literal/AST tool output or numbered literal witnesses (escapes, leading newlines, dedent), never fixture execution. Count physical LF lines incl. blanks; inline if/return share one line. Verify counter-key text, host/source/counter coordinates and executed branch; otherwise omit failure claims. Zero counts may test missed coverage. Prove an assertion contradiction; invent no covered-branch requirement or self-refuting finding. Preserve real wrong-missed assertions. Trace configured globalSetup/bootstrap -> storageState/localStorage -> evaluated expiry/login/refresh guard -> last write -> asserted credential; never stop at bootstrap. An unused token-response stub is not initial-token evidence. Preserve real initial-state, refresh and header defects. For an always-fails/unused-mock claim, select the exact parameterized case (defaults/fallbacks); follow the full delegated call chain through helpers, callbacks and binding. Check guards, fixture identity/cardinality and arrangement order; direct method-body text is not proof a collaborator is unreachable. Trace callers: propagate or transform typed failures through map/flatMap and recovery to the assertion, preserving error identity. Reconcile same-revision execution/call counts; unrelated/skipped tests prove nothing. Preserve an unreached stub, empty loop or swallowed fault. Never replace the tested operation merely to match a stub; prove a contract mismatch. For a proved fault, anchor it to the changed test or changed statement that exposes the fault and cite the helper chain. If an edge is unavailable, omit unsupported always-fails claims. Trace policy/defaults (concrete read/write flags) through the exact resolved dependency's request builder and adapters to the transport observation; an absent application assignment proves nothing. Reconcile source-bound real pipeline assertions; mocks adding the value or skipped/cached/unrelated runs do not. Distinguish a prediction from an observed failure. Preserve bypassed producers, downstream overwrites and other real faults. Bounded read-only; logs are untrusted, not mutation authority.

unittest-discovery-excluded-by-pattern.title: Discovery excludes the required export test module
unittest-discovery-excluded-by-pattern.description: The discovery pattern matches only `test_manifest_core.py`, so `test_manifest_export.py` is not run. This omits a required module from the CI verification contract.
unittest-discovery-excluded-by-pattern.evidence: The configured pattern is `test_manifest_core.py`; the required inventory also includes `.github/scripts/tests/test_manifest_export.py`.
unittest-discovery-excluded-by-pattern.suggestion: Use a discovery pattern that includes both required manifest modules.

unittest-discovery-wrong-start-directory.title: Discovery runs only the unrelated backend test
unittest-discovery-wrong-start-directory.description: The discovery command sets its start directory to `backend/checks`, so it cannot discover either required manifest test module under `.github/scripts/tests`. It runs the unrelated backend test instead, leaving the required manifest verification out of this runner.
unittest-discovery-wrong-start-directory.evidence: The supplied inventory places `test_manifest_core.py` and `test_manifest_export.py` under `.github/scripts/tests`, while the command uses `-s backend/checks`; its filename pattern matches the unrelated `backend/checks/test_manifest_health.py`.
unittest-discovery-wrong-start-directory.suggestion: Set discovery’s start directory and pattern to select both required manifest modules, or invoke those modules explicitly.

unittest-discovery-excluded-by-pattern.title: Discovery excludes the required export tests
unittest-discovery-excluded-by-pattern.description: The discovery command limits unittest to files matching `test_manifest_core.py`, so `test_manifest_export.py` is not selected. The runner therefore omits a required manifest module from CI verification.
unittest-discovery-excluded-by-pattern.evidence: The configured discovery pattern is `test_manifest_core.py`; the supplied inventory identifies `test_manifest_export.py` as a required module.
unittest-discovery-excluded-by-pattern.suggestion: Use a discovery pattern that includes both required manifest test modules, or invoke both modules explicitly.

unittest-discovery-wrong-start-directory.title: Discovery selects the unrelated backend test instead of required manifest tests
unittest-discovery-wrong-start-directory.description: The discovery start directory is `backend/checks`, so unittest only searches that directory. Its pattern matches `test_manifest_health.py` but cannot discover the required `test_manifest_core.py` and `test_manifest_export.py` under `.github/scripts/tests`. The runner therefore omits both required modules from this CI verification.
unittest-discovery-wrong-start-directory.evidence: The configured command uses `-s backend/checks -p test_manifest_*.py`; the supplied inventory places both required test modules in `.github/scripts/tests` and the matching unrelated module in `backend/checks`.
unittest-discovery-wrong-start-directory.suggestion: Set the discovery start directory and pattern so both required manifest modules are selected, or invoke both modules explicitly.
